sanskrit: īṣad utsmayamānas tu kṛṣṇo rājānam abravīt yudhiṣṭhiraṃ hatāmitraṃ kṛtāñjalir athācyutaḥ
english: Then Kṛṣṇa, the Acyuta, smiling faintly, his hands folded in reverence, spoke to King Yudhiṣṭhira, whose enemy was now slain.

sanskrit: diṣṭyā gāṇḍīvadhanvā ca pāṇḍavaś ca vṛkodaraḥ tvaṃ cāpi kuśalī rājan mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau
english: "By good fortune the wielder of the Gāṇḍīva and the Pāṇḍava Vṛkodara are safe, and you yourself, O king, are well, and Mādrī's two sons, the Pāṇḍavas."

sanskrit: muktā vīrakṣayād asmāt saṃgrāmāl lomaharṣaṇāt kṣipram uttarakālāni kuru kāryāṇi pārthiva
english: "You have been delivered from this destruction of heroes, from this hair-raising battle. Swiftly now, O lord of the earth, attend to the tasks of the time that follows."

sanskrit: hato vaikartanaḥ krūraḥ sūtaputro mahābalaḥ diṣṭyā jayasi rājendra diṣṭyā vardhasi pāṇḍava
english: "The cruel Vaikartana, the mighty son of the charioteer, is slain. By good fortune you are victorious, O lord of kings; by good fortune you prosper, O Pāṇḍava."

sanskrit: yaḥ sa dyūtajitāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ prāhasat puruṣādhamaḥ tasyādya sūtaputrasya bhūmiḥ pibati śoṇitam
english: "That basest of men who once laughed at Kṛṣṇā when she was won at the gambling match — today the earth drinks the blood of that son of the charioteer."

sanskrit: śete 'sau śaradīrṇāṅgaḥ śatrus te kurupuṃgava taṃ paśya puruṣavyāghra vibhinnaṃ bahudhā śaraiḥ
english: "That foe of yours lies there, his limbs torn by arrows, O bull of the Kurus. Behold him, O tiger among men, pierced in many places by shafts."

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhiras tu dāśārhaṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ pratyapūjayat diṣṭyā diṣṭyeti rājendra prītyā cedam uvāca ha
english: Yudhiṣṭhira, greatly delighted, honored in turn the scion of the Dāśārhas, crying "By good fortune! By good fortune!" O lord of kings, and then, in his joy, he spoke these words.

sanskrit: naitac citraṃ mahābāho tvayi devakinandana tvayā sārathinā pārtho yat kuryād adya pauruṣam
english: "This is no wonder in you, O mighty-armed son of Devakī — that with you as his charioteer Pārtha should this day perform such a feat of manhood."

sanskrit: pragṛhya ca kuruśreṣṭhaḥ sāṅgadaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ bhujam uvāca dharmabhṛt pārtha ubhau tau keśavārjunau
english: And the best of the Kurus, the upholder of righteousness, taking hold of the right arm adorned with its armlet, addressed both Keśava and Arjuna, calling on Pārtha.

sanskrit: naranārāyaṇau devau kathitau nāradena ha dharmasaṃsthāpane yuktau purāṇau puruṣottamau
english: "You two were declared by Nārada to be the gods Nara and Nārāyaṇa, the ancient and supreme among men, appointed for the establishment of righteousness."

sanskrit: asakṛc cāpi medhāvī kṛṣṇadvaipāyano mama kathām etāṃ mahābāho divyām akathayat prabhuḥ
english: "And more than once the wise lord Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana told me this divine tale, O mighty-armed one."

sanskrit: tava kṛṣṇa prabhāveṇa gāṇḍīvena dhanaṃjayaḥ jayaty abhimukhāñ śatrūn na cāsīd vimukhaḥ kva cit
english: "By your power, O Kṛṣṇa, Dhanaṃjaya with the Gāṇḍīva conquers the foes who stand before him, and nowhere has he ever turned his back."

sanskrit: jayaś caiva dhruvo 'smākaṃ na tv asmākaṃ parājayaḥ yadā tvaṃ yudhi pārthasya sārathyam upajagmivān
english: "Victory is assured for us, and never defeat, since you have taken up the office of Pārtha's charioteer in battle."

sanskrit: evam uktvā mahārāja taṃ rathaṃ hemabhūṣitam dantavarṇair hayair yuktaṃ kālavālair mahārathaḥ
english: Having spoken thus, O great king, that mighty warrior mounted the chariot adorned with gold, yoked with horses ivory-white in hue and black-tailed,

sanskrit: āsthāya puruṣavyāghraḥ svabalenābhisaṃvṛtaḥ kṛṣṇārjunābhyāṃ vīrābhyām anumanya tataḥ priyam
english: that tiger among men, surrounded by his own forces; and then, taking leave with kind regard of the two heroes Kṛṣṇa and Arjuna,

sanskrit: āgato bahuvṛttāntaṃ draṣṭum āyodhanaṃ tadā ābhāṣamāṇas tau vīrāv ubhau mādhavaphalgunau
english: he came to behold the battlefield with its many turns of fortune, conversing all the while with those two heroes, Mādhava and Phalguna.

sanskrit: sa dadarśa raṇe karṇaṃ śayānaṃ puruṣarṣabham gāṇḍīvamuktair viśikhaiḥ sarvataḥ śakalīkṛtam
english: He saw Karṇa, that bull among men, lying on the field of battle, hewn to pieces on every side by the shafts loosed from the Gāṇḍīva.

sanskrit: saputraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ praśaśaṃsa naravyāghrāv ubhau mādhavapāṇḍavau
english: Seeing Karṇa slain together with his son, King Yudhiṣṭhira praised both those tigers among men, Mādhava and the Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit: adya rājāsmi govinda pṛthivyāṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha tvayā nāthena vīreṇa viduṣā paripālitaḥ
english: "This day I am a king upon the earth, O Govinda, together with my brothers, protected by you, my lord, a hero and a sage."

sanskrit: hataṃ dṛṣṭvā naravyāghraṃ rādheyam abhimāninam nirāśo 'dya durātmāsau dhārtarāṣṭro bhaviṣyati jīvitāc cāpi rājyāc ca hate karṇe mahārathe
english: "Seeing the proud Rādheya, that tiger among men, struck down, this evil-souled son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra will today despair of his very life and of his kingdom both, now that the great warrior Karṇa is slain."

sanskrit: tvatprasādād vayaṃ caiva kṛtārthāḥ puruṣarṣabha tvaṃ ca gāṇḍīvadhanvā ca vijayī yadunandana diṣṭyā jayasi govinda diṣṭyā karṇo nipātitaḥ
english: "By your grace we too have attained our purpose, O bull among men; you and the wielder of the Gāṇḍīva are the victors, O joy of the Yadus. By good fortune you triumph, O Govinda; by good fortune Karṇa has been brought down."

sanskrit: evaṃ sa bahuśo hṛṣṭaḥ praśaśaṃsa janārdanam arjunaṃ cāpi rājendra dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: Thus, again and again, in his great gladness, did Yudhiṣṭhira the Dharmarāja praise Janārdana and Arjuna too, O lord of kings.

sanskrit: tato bhīmaprabhṛtibhiḥ sarvaiś ca bhrātṛbhir vṛtam vardhayanti sma rājānaṃ harṣayuktā mahārathāḥ
english: Then, surrounded by all his brothers headed by Bhīma, the great warriors, filled with joy, hailed the king with their praises.

sanskrit: nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca pāṇḍavaś ca vṛkodaraḥ sātyakiś ca mahārāja vṛṣṇīnāṃ pravaro rathaḥ
english: Nakula and Sahadeva, and the Pāṇḍava Vṛkodara, and Sātyaki, O great king, the foremost chariot-warrior of the Vṛṣṇis,

sanskrit: dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca pāṇḍupāñcālasṛñjayāḥ pūjayanti sma kaunteyaṃ nihate sūtanandane
english: Dhṛṣṭadyumna and Śikhaṇḍin, and the Pāṇḍavas, the Pāñcālas, and the Sṛñjayas — all honored the son of Kuntī, now that the son of the charioteer was slain.

sanskrit: te vardhayitvā nṛpatiṃ pāṇḍuputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram jitakāśino labdhalakṣā yuddhaśauṇḍāḥ prahāriṇaḥ
english: Having hailed the king, Pāṇḍu's son Yudhiṣṭhira — they who bore the look of conquerors, who had attained their aim, those battle-drunk smiters,

sanskrit: stuvantaḥ stavayuktābhir vāgbhiḥ kṛṣṇau paraṃtapau jagmuḥ svaśibirāyaiva mudā yuktā mahārathāḥ
english: praising the two Kṛṣṇas, those scorchers of foes, with words full of laudation, the great warriors, joined with gladness, went each to his own camp.

sanskrit: evam eṣa kṣayo vṛttaḥ sumahāṃl lomaharṣaṇaḥ tava durmantrite rājann atītaṃ kiṃ nu śocasi
english: "Thus did this vast and hair-raising destruction come to pass, through your evil counsel, O king. Why now do you grieve for what is past?"

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca śrutvā tad apriyaṃ rājan dhṛtarāṣṭro mahīpatiḥ papāta bhūmau niśceṣṭaḥ kauravyaḥ paramārtivān tathā satyavratā devī gāndhārī dharmadarśinī
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having heard those unwelcome tidings, O king, Dhṛtarāṣṭra the lord of the earth, that Kaurava, overcome with utmost anguish, fell senseless to the ground, and so too did the lady Gāndhārī, faithful to her vows and seer of righteousness.

sanskrit: taṃ pratyagṛhṇād viduro nṛpatiṃ saṃjayas tathā paryāśvāsayataś caivaṃ tāv ubhāv eva bhūmipam
english: Vidura caught the king as he fell, and Saṃjaya likewise, and both of them sought to comfort that lord of the earth.

sanskrit: tathaivotthāpayām āsur gāndhārīṃ rājayoṣitaḥ tābhyām āśvāsito rājā tūṣṇīm āsīd vicetanaḥ
english: In the same way the women of the royal household raised up Gāndhārī. Comforted by those two, the king sat silent, his senses gone.
